prompt:

Derive the requested conjugated verb form from the Sanskrit verbal root (dhatu, given in

verb class (gana), its traditional meaning (artha), and the required
tense/mood (lakara), voice (prayoga), person (purusha), and number (vacana).
Each Sanskrit grammatical term is glossed in parentheses in English.

Write ONLY the final conjugated verb form, in Devanagari script, inside
<answer></answer> tags. If several forms are valid, give exactly one.
Do not include any text outside the answer tags.

=== Your task ===

dhatu (Sanskrit verbal root): प्री॒ञ्   (Dhatupatha citation form, anubandha markers included)
gana (verb class): Kryadi (class 9)
artha (traditional meaning): तर्पणे कान्तौ च

Required form:
- lakara (tense/mood): Lot (imperative)
- prayoga (voice): Kartari (active)
- purusha (person): Uttama (first person)
- vacana (number): Dvi (dual)
